assessment.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci vážných bezpečnostních a sociálních výzev, včetně pokračujících ruských útoků na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu a výpadků systému Starlink. Masivní generální stávka v gpointer-Španělsku kvůli cenám bydlení a eskalace politického napětí na jihu kontinentu zvyšují vnitřní nestabilitu. Tyto faktory spolu s geopolitickým tlakem na obranu vytvářejí složité prostředí pro finanční trhy a instituce EU.
assessment.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of severe security and social challenges, including ongoing Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy grid and disruptions to the Starlink system. A massive general strike in Spain over housing costs and escalating political tensions in southern Europe are heightening internal instability. These factors, alongside geopolitical pressures on defense, create a complex operating environment for financial markets and EU institutions.

assessment.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react to diplomatic developments regarding Ukraine and the stabilization of the situation following social unrest in Spain.

assessment.forecast_review_en: The previous forecast was partially confirmed as markets reacted both to diplomatic talks on Ukraine and to sharp social and political unrest in southern Europe.

articles.title: Trump won't save Ukraine. But Marine Le Pen's betrayal could be worse | Mujtaba Rahman
articles.summary:
European leaders need urgently to prepare for a far-right French president who would cut off Kyiv’s financial lifeline

Europe is consumed by two debates that matter less than it thinks, while neglecting one that matters enormously. The first is who should represent the EU in negotiations with Russia. This is largely irrelevant because there is little prospect of serious Ukraine peace talks before the end of winter - despite the fanfare that has surrounded discussions in Abu Dhabi this week. Russia has powerful incentives to escalate the war over the coming months in an attempt to break Ukraine’s economy and civilian morale.

The second is Donald Trump’s approach to Ukraine. This matters less than it once did – and not only because he is now more constrained by a Democratic Congress. Since returning to office in January 2025, Trump has provided no new US military aid to Kyiv. American weapons sales remain important to Ukraine’s war effort, but Trump’s military interventions in the Middle East have further strained supplies of the weapons Ukraine needs most – notably Patriot interceptors.

Mujtaba Rahman is the managing director for Europe at Eurasia Group, a political risk research and consulting firm

Antonio Cremasco contracted Covid at a dinner party on 6 March 2020. Four days later, as Italy became the first European country to go into nationwide lockdown, he was fighting for his life. “I spent 20 days in intensive care, followed by another 20 days in a hospital ward,” said Cremasco, from Bassano del Grappa in the northern Italian Veneto region.

After leaving hospital, he needed oxygen therapy for another six months. Cremasco’s ordeal was such that when Covid vaccines became available in Italy in early 2021, he had no qualms about being vaccinated, and he believes the decision saved his life once again.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně vnitřních sociálních nepokojů, protestů a stávok v zemích jako Francie, zatímco přetrvávající inflační tlaky udržují Evropskou centrální banku v kurzu dalšího zpřísňování měnové politiky. Na geopolitické scéně eskalují dopady amerických politických zvratů na transatlantické vztahy a ukrajinský konflikt pokračuje s vysokou intenzitou ruských útoků na civilní infrastrukturu.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of domestic social unrest, protests, and strikes in countries like France, while persistent inflation pressures keep the European Central Bank on course for further monetary policy tightening. On the geopolitical front, the spillover effects of US political shifts on transatlantic relations are escalating, and the war in Ukraine continues with intense Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further waves of strikes and protests in Western Europe, heightened focus on critical infrastructure cybersecurity, and tense negotiations over financing aid to Ukraine outside the EU budget framework can be expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí eskalujícím sociálním nepokojům, vlnám stávek v západních zemích kvůli životním nákladům a pokračujícím fatálním útokům na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu. archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí komplexní vlně bezpečnostních a sociálních výzev, včetně koordovaných bombových hrozeb napříč státy, rostoucího napětí ve Španělsku kvůli bytové krizi a pokračujících trilateralních jednání o Ukrajině v Abú Dhabí. archive.security_status_en: Europe faces a complex wave of security and social challenges, including coordinated cross-border bomb threats, rising domestic tensions in Spain over the housing crisis, and ongoing trilateral Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi. Simultaneously, the ECB is monitoring slightly rising wage pressures, while geopolitical tensions spill over into cybersecurity and energy sectors.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to digest the outcomes of the Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi and react to political and social unrest in Southern Europe.

Mezitím probíhají klíčová jednání o budoucím bezpečnostním uspořádání Ukrajiny a unijní instituce řeší legislativní pat v oblasti pracovních práv a klimatické politiky.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest, led by Spain where mass general strikes and housing protests have erupted into violent clashes with police. Meanwhile, critical talks on Ukraine's post-war security framework continue alongside legislative stalemates in EU institutions regarding labor rights and climate policy.

Masivní generální stávka v gpointer-Španělsku kvůli cenám bydlení a eskalace politického napětí na jihu kontinentu zvyšují vnitřní nestabilitu. Tyto faktory spolu s geopolitickým tlakem na obranu vytvářejí složité prostředí pro finanční trhy a instituce EU.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of severe security and social challenges, including ongoing Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy grid and disruptions to the Starlink system. A massive general strike in Spain over housing costs and escalating political tensions in southern Europe are heightening internal instability. These factors, alongside geopolitical pressures on defense, create a complex operating environment for financial markets and EU institutions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává reakce trhů na vývoj diplomatických jednání ohledně Ukrajiny a stabilizaci situace po sociálních nepokojích ve Španělsku.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react to diplomatic developments regarding Ukraine and the stabilization of the situation following social unrest in Spain.
